3. Typography

Two voices carry every surface. A name is engraved: a fixed part of the case is labeled in narrow capitals. A value is displayed: anything read off the system is set in a monospace face. Everything a person reads as a sentence is sentence case.

Families and Licenses

FamilyRoleLicenseFiles
Instrument Sans Variable, weight 400 to 700, width 75 to 100Names, headings and readingSIL OFL 1.1, fonts/OFL-Instrument-Sans.txt2 woff2, 76 kB
Martian Mono Variable, weight 100 to 800, width 75 to 112.5Values, code, readoutsSIL OFL 1.1, fonts/OFL-Martian-Mono.txt2 woff2, 63 kB
Inter Display MediumThe wordmark onlySIL OFL 1.1None: it is outlines in the logo files

The files are @fontsource-variable/instrument-sans and @fontsource-variable/martian-mono 5.3.0, byte for byte, and src/fonts/fonts.lock.json pins each file's SHA-256: build.mjs refuses a font file that differs. css/fonts.css holds only the @font-face rules, so the loading can be swapped in one place. Each family has its Latin and Latin Extended subsets, which cover English, German, French and Spanish; a page in another script falls back to the system's face.

Read the families from --nc-font-sans and --nc-font-mono. Each stack ends in system faces, so text is set before the web font arrives, with font-display: swap.

Width Is Part of the Voice

Instrument Sans is set at 82% for engraved labels, 86% for headings and 100% for text. Martian Mono is set at 75% for values and code, where one character is 0.6 em wide: a listing 830 pixels wide holds a line of 100 characters at 13 pixels. On a readout it is set at 100%.

Roles

A role is a font shorthand, --nc-type-<role>, with its width and its letter spacing beside it as --nc-type-<role>-stretch and --nc-type-<role>-tracking. Set them together. The label role is the one uppercase role, and it carries its case as --nc-type-label-case; a mono role also turns on the slashed zero, font-feature-settings: "zero" 1.

.column-head {
  font: var(--nc-type-label);
  font-stretch: var(--nc-type-label-stretch);
  letter-spacing: var(--nc-type-label-tracking);
  text-transform: var(--nc-type-label-case);
}

The Scale

Sizes in pixels at the default root size: 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 17, 19, 22, 28, 36, 44, 56, 76. The interface is set at 14, dense interface and code at 13, long-form documentation at 17. On a phone a field of the console, a dialog, the sign-in pages and the site bar is 16, so the browser does not zoom into it; a small field of the console or a dialog, .well--sm, stays at 13. The scale's steps are primitives: a component reads a role, not a step.

Do and Don't

  • Do set a field's label in sentence case, and show the key a setting is stored under beside it as a value.
  • Do set an ID, a count, a date, a hash or a secret as a value, in Martian Mono.
  • Don't engrave a sentence, a caption or a field's label.
  • Don't set prose in monospace, or a value in the label voice.
  • Don't load Inter for interface text: it is the wordmark's face, and only as outlines in the logo files.
